functions.name: create_listing
functions.title: Create listing
functions.description: Creates a new housing sublease listing on behalf of the signed-in verified student. Only callable by users with a .edu email. Pass the full listing payload; the server sets status, expiry, and availability timestamp.

year.description: Calendar year of the term, e.g. 2027.

location.description: General area or address of the property.

apartment_complex.description: Optional name of the apartment complex.

utility_estimate.description: Optional estimated monthly utilities in USD.

utilities_subsidized.description: True if utilities are partly or fully included.

roommates_bio.description: Optional short bio of current roommates (max 2000 chars).

bio.description: Optional longer description of the place (max 3000 chars).

photos.description: Array of photo URLs; at least one required.

contact_method.description: How the host wants to be contacted.

contact_value.description: The handle, phone, or email matching contact_method.
